tasks.label: Batch switch factor trade_date to close_time
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $files = Get-ChildItem -Path 'd:/Crypto/Factor' -Filter '*.py' -File; $changed=0; foreach($f in $files){ $text = Get-Content -Path $f.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $orig = $text; $text = $text.Replace('[\"open_time\", \"open\", \"high\", \"low\", \"close\", \"volume\"]','[\"close_time\", \"open\", \"high\", \"low\", \"close\", \"volume\"]'); $text = $text.Replace('[\"open_time\", \"open\", \"high\", \"low\", \"close\", \"volume\", \"quote_volume\", \"count\", \"oi\", \"OpenInterest\"]','[\"close_time\", \"open\", \"high\", \"low\", \"close\", \"volume\", \"quote_volume\", \"count\", \"oi\", \"OpenInterest\"]'); $text = $text.Replace('df = df.dropna(subset=[\"open_time\", \"close\"]).copy()','df = df.dropna(subset=[\"close_time\", \"close\"]).copy()'); $text = $text.Replace('df = df.sort_values(\"open_time\")','df = df.sort_values(\"close_time\")'); $text = $text.Replace('df[\"trade_date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"open_time\"], unit=\"ms\", utc=True).dt.strftime(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")','df[\"trade_date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"close_time\"], unit=\"ms\", utc=True).dt.strftime(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")'); $text = $text.Replace('if \"open_time\" not in df.columns or \"close\" not in df.columns:','if \"close_time\" not in df.columns or \"close\" not in df.columns:'); $text = $text.Replace('kline file must include columns: open_time, close','kline file must include columns: close_time, close'); if($text -ne $orig){ Set-Content -Path $f.FullName -Value $text -Encoding UTF8; $changed++ } }; Write-Output \"CHANGED_FILES=$changed\""

tasks.label: Use close_time string as trade_date
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$files = Get-ChildItem -Path 'd:/Crypto/Factor' -Filter '*.py' -File; $changed=0; foreach($f in $files){ $text = Get-Content -Path $f.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $orig = $text; $text = $text.Replace('df[\"trade_date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"close_time\"], unit=\"ms\", utc=True).dt.strftime(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")','df[\"trade_date\"] = df[\"close_time\"].astype(str)'); if($f.Name -eq 'CrossSectional_Skewness.py'){ $text = $text.Replace('df[\"open_time\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"open_time\"], errors=\"coerce\")','df[\"close_time\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"close_time\"], errors=\"coerce\")'); $text = $text.Replace('# Binance open_time is millisecond timestamp; keep full bar timestamp granularity.','# Use close_time as trade_date for crypto bars.'); }; if($text -ne $orig){ Set-Content -Path $f.FullName -Value $text -Encoding UTF8; $changed++ } }; Write-Output \"CHANGED_FILES=$changed\""
